ai.title: CLI: Pause timer during askuser tool
ai.summary: Added pause/resume logic to `useElapsedTime` hook and `SendMessageTimerController` to freeze the status bar timer when the `ask_user` tool is active. `chat.tsx` triggers these methods based on `askUserState`, while `status-bar.tsx` renders a frozen elapsed time instead of resetting or hiding the indicator. Scope covers CLI core utilities (`use-elapsed-time.ts`, `send-message-timer.ts`) and UI components (`status-bar.tsx`, `chat.tsx`).

eli5.text: When the assistant asks you for input through the ask_user tool, the elapsed-time counter in the command-line status bar now freezes instead of continuing to tick or resetting. The timer pauses while you're being prompted and resumes once you respond, keeping the same accumulated time visible while frozen. This applies to anyone using the CLI when an ask_user prompt appears, and it is live today.

ai.title: Fix multi-byte IME input in CLI multiline component
ai.summary: Updated `multiline-input.tsx` to accept multi-byte characters from IME. Replaced strict `sequence.length === 1` check with `isPrintableCharacterKey` heuristic handling keys with no name or single-char name. Fixes input for Chinese, Japanese, Korean. Scope limited to CLI components.

eli5.text: You can now type Chinese, Japanese, and Korean characters one piece at a time into the CLI's text input, instead of each character being ignored or split apart. Previously, the input only accepted keys with exactly one character, so multi-character symbols from input method editors slipped through the cracks; the new check quietly recognizes these multi-byte symbols as legitimate text. The change is already live for anyone using the CLI's multi-line input box.
